# Vendored headers

Builds use these local copies and do not download dependencies:

- `json.hpp`: [nlohmann/json v3.12.0](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0), MIT. See `JSON-LICENSE.MIT`.
- `picosha2.h`: [PicoSHA2 commit 161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29](https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2/tree/161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29), MIT. See `PICOSHA2-LICENSE`.
- `portable-file-dialogs.h`: [Portable File Dialogs commit c12ea8c9a727f5320a2b4570aee863bbede2a204](https://github.com/samhocevar/portable-file-dialogs/tree/c12ea8c9a727f5320a2b4570aee863bbede2a204), WTFPL v2. See `PFD-COPYING`.

The headers are unmodified and retain their original notices.
